Introducing the new

Remotely control Google TV straight from your computer

Available on the Chrome Web Store

Take a look and learn about Chromemote and what it can do!

The right way to control TV is here

Why fumble through a bunch of clunky remotes when you can use the computer in front of you?

Chromemote is an extension for the Google Chrome web browser that adds full remote control of any Google TV, directly from within the web browser.

An easy way to enjoy the TV experience while using a computer. Aside from basic TV controls, you can also send and control content to and from your computer.
